title: Markdown editor
summary: A field for writing Markdown: a real textarea whose value is the Markdown text, a formatting toolbar (bold, italic, heading, quote, code, bulleted and numbered lists, link) and a Write / Preview switch. The preview is built from the parsed text with DOM calls only: raw HTML is shown as text and a link must be http, https, mailto or a relative address. Form-associated like pk-textarea. The Markdown subset is paragraphs, bold, italic, code, fenced code, headings 1 to 3, quotes, lists and links; the same parser and renderer are in js/markdown/ for showing stored text elsewhere (never write the value into markup yourself).

props.name: value
props.description: The Markdown text; what the form submits. A form reset sets it back to its initial value without raising pk-change, as a native control does.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the writing area. pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks editing and commands and takes the toolbar out of the tab order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: The text can be read, selected and previewed, but not edited; the toolbar does nothing.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot submit while the text is empty.

props.name: maxlength
props.description: Maximum text length; a command that would exceed it does nothing.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible rows of the writing area.

props.name: mode
props.description: Which pane shows: write or preview. The Write / Preview tabs change it.

props.name: layout
props.description: tabs: one pane at a time. split: write and preview side by side while the field is at least 640px wide (the tabs return when narrower).

props.name: toolbar
props.default: bold italic heading quote code ul ol link
props.description: The toolbar commands, space separated, in order: bold, italic, heading, quote, code, ul, ol, link. Enter in a list continues it (and ends it on an empty item); pasting an http, https or mailto address over selected text makes it a link. Ctrl/Cmd+B, I and K work in the textarea for the commands that are listed.

events.name: input
events.description: The text changed by typing (native, composed).

events.name: change
events.description: The user left the field after editing (native).

events.name: pk-change
events.description: The user committed a new value: the field lost focus after typing, or a toolbar command or shortcut changed the text.

parts.name: head
parts.description: The tab strip and toolbar row.

parts.name: commands
parts.description: The formatting buttons (role toolbar, one tab stop, arrow keys move).

parts.name: linkbar
parts.description: The link address row, shown by the link command.

parts.name: link-ok
parts.description: The button that adds the link.

parts.name: link-cancel
parts.description: The button that closes the link row.

a11y: The writing area is a native textarea named by label. The formatting buttons form one toolbar with a name, one Tab stop and Left/Right, Home and End to move; Escape returns to the textarea. Ctrl/Cmd+B, I and K are announced with aria-keyshortcuts and do nothing during IME composition. The preview is a named region.

examples.title: Split layout, shorter toolbar
examples.html:
<pk-markdown-editor label="Notes" layout="split" toolbar="bold italic link" rows="5" value="# Notes

- one
- two"></pk-markdown-editor>

writes.target: the pk-button commands in its toolbar
writes.why: The editor builds the formatting buttons in its own shadow tree and keeps one of them in the tab order (roving tabindex on the real button inside each).
